text: Fear of the sea, especially at night. I couldn't go to the beach that summer. Nightmares of black water and hands reaching up. My fingers had scars from the barnacles and looking at them brought it back. It eased after about a year.
Seitdem habe ich Klaustrophobie. Ich kann keine kleinen Toiletten mehr abschließen, fahre nicht gern Aufzug und bekomme in engen Räumen Panik. Das ist bis heute so.

The months after the retreat were some of the darkest of my life, and I've had dark times before.

What the shaman said got under my skin. Even though I knew rationally that he was a transphobic man abusing his power, part of me kept asking: what if he's right? What if I'm confused? What if I've ruined my life? I'd look in the mirror and see the boy from the visions. I'd hear my deadname in his voice. I had periods where I couldn't bear to look at my own body, which hadn't happened since before my transition.

My dysphoria, which had been well managed, came back with a vengeance. I stopped going out. I stopped dating. I stopped wearing makeup for a while because I felt like a fraud.

I had intrusive memories of his hand on my chest, the smell of the tobacco, the singing. Tobacco smoke anywhere would trigger me. I couldn't go near anyone smoking. I had nightmares where he was standing over my bed singing and I couldn't move.

I developed severe depression and, for the first time in years, suicidal thoughts. My trans friends noticed and stayed close to me. I think they saved my life.

I also became very anxious in any spiritual or 'wellness' setting. Even yoga classes made me tense, wondering if the teacher would turn out to be like him.

Physically, I had trouble sleeping and lost my appetite. I felt like I was in a fog much of the time.

The anger came later. Anger at him, at the facilitators, at myself for going. The anger was actually a sign that I was getting better, I think.
Sometimes I think about that clown at night and get a bit spooked, but it's not a real problem.
Eher Erkenntnisse über mich als Probleme. Ich achte jetzt besser auf meine Grenzen.

I couldn't fly for two years after that. It cost me a family wedding and my grandmother's 90th birthday, both of which I missed. Even thinking about airports gave me panic attacks. I also felt a lot of shame about having done something so stupid. When I finally flew again, with medication and after therapy, I had a panic attack during take-off but managed.

Seit dieser Nacht habe ich immer wieder Phasen von Depersonalisation. Ich fühle mich dann wie hinter Glas, als wäre ich nicht wirklich da. Die ersten Monate waren am schlimmsten, da war es fast dauerhaft. Ich hatte große Angst, dass es nie wieder weggeht, und habe deswegen eine Depression entwickelt. Ich konnte mich kaum konzentrieren und habe mein Studium für ein Semester unterbrochen. Ich habe mich von meinen Freunden zurückgezogen, weil ich das Gefühl hatte, nur noch eine Hülle zu sein. Heute kommen die Phasen seltener, meist wenn ich müde oder gestresst bin.

Health anxiety and anger at myself. For months I was afraid of any medication. I also felt guilty about lying to the retreat. My depression got worse for a while because I was too scared to restart the SSRI.

The breakup would have been painful anyway, but the way it happened left something more. For months I had flashbacks of the river, of his face changing. Rivers became unbearable. I developed a deep distrust of people, especially partners. I'd examine people's faces for signs that they were hiding something. I became depressed and didn't date for over a year. I also had moments of derealisation, mostly in the first weeks, where the world felt like a fake film set again.
Nur der Fuß, der ein paar Monate gebraucht hat. Psychisch nichts.

The trip cracked open the box where I'd kept all the bad calls. For about a year I had flashbacks of that house fire, and others, much more than before. I couldn't go to barbecues or sit near open fires. I had trouble at work, I froze at a car fire and my captain had to send me back to the truck. I became irritable and drank more. My wife said I was distant. I eventually took leave.

Nach dieser Nacht hatte ich große Angst vor Krankenhäusern und Polizei. Ich habe mich vor meiner Mitbewohnerin geschämt und bin ein paar Wochen später ausgezogen. Ich hatte noch lange das Bild des kahlen Zimmers mit der Tür ohne Klinke im Kopf, vor allem nachts. Ich fühlte mich bestraft dafür, dass es mir schlecht ging, und habe mich danach erst recht nicht getraut, mit jemandem über meine düsteren Gedanken zu sprechen.
